text.insert: The design system is the shared UI for the Codecaine apps and the owner's personal apps. This page gives its scope, the apps that consume it, how a token change reaches each app, and the record of the first rollout.
The design system is the shared UI for one ecosystem with two parts.
The first part is the Codecaine apps and libraries. These are the Core repos docs-system, canvas, sequence, agent-kernel, prompt-kit, annotations and observatory, and the tools around them.
The second part is the owner's personal apps, such as budget.

Sites with their own custom look stay outside the design system. personal-site is excluded and keeps its own UI, by an owner decision on 2026-10-07. Product looks inside an in-scope app also stay as they are, such as game scenes and exports, landing heroes and brand pages.

text.insert: Three groups of apps carry extra rules: the n/a passes, the pending apps and the dark-first surfaces.
Libraries have no pass 3. The libraries are docs-viewer, docs-publish, viewer-shell, viewer-ui, prompt-kit-ui and annotations.
Libraries and leaf renderers have no pass 2, because they render inside a host's shell.
Each n/a pass carries its reason in the registry entry.
Uncommitted work in its repo blocks every pending app.
The action is to commit that work.
The pending apps are the next batch.
The dark-first surfaces are skitzo, docs-mcp-home, mainmenu, gamecube and circlesnakes-panels.
They use the same tokens, dark by default, and are checked in dark only.
Every other entry supports light and dark.
